content.title: Why NASA’s Artemis Mission Needs So Much Liquid Hydrogen Fuel | WION Podcast
content.text: In this episode, we explain why NASA’s Artemis mission depends on massive amounts of liquid hydrogen fuel. From lifting the heavy Space Launch System off the ground to powering deep space travel, this super-cold fuel plays a crucial role. Discover how engineers store, manage, and use hydrogen at extreme temperatures. Learn why efficiency matters in space exploration.
